intro: The ten most-played Roblox games this week. Brookhaven jumps to No. 2, Throw Food For Animals keeps climbing, Murder Mystery 2 cools off after Halloween, and Jujutsu Shenanigans is new.
method: Ranked by player counts on the public tracker Endgametools (snapshot Nov 16, 2026, 22:23 UTC), cross-checked with Livecounts (Nov 17, 12:06 UTC) and Rokoala (Nov 17, 03:52 UTC). The trackers disagree in places: Livecounts had Throw Food For Animals at No. 2 and Break and Steal an Egg at No. 8.

entries.name: Steal An Egg
entries.note: Still No. 1 by a mile, with about 514,000 players on Nov 16.

entries.name: Brookhaven RP
entries.note: Up one, with about 334,000 players on Nov 16.

entries.name: Adopt Me!
entries.note: Up two, with about 228,000 players on Endgametools' latest reading.

entries.name: Throw Food For Animals
entries.note: Still climbing: about 208,000 players on Nov 16, and No. 2 on Livecounts on Nov 17.

entries.name: Murder Mystery 2
entries.note: Down four after Halloween, with about 121,000 players on Nov 16.

entries.name: RIVALS
entries.note: Unchanged at No. 7 with about 108,000 players.

entries.name: Jujutsu Shenanigans
entries.note: New: the anime fighter had about 80,000 players on Nov 16.

entries.name: Dandy's World [ALPHA]
entries.note: Down one with about 69,000 players on Endgametools' latest reading.
